13:05.race_name: Happy Birthday David Griffin Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Dr V Roger-Yves Simon & Nicolas Simon &
runners.comment: Promise in bumpers but well-held fifth on hurdle debut and Cobden looks elsewhere
runners.name: A King Of Magic
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when reaching the frame in two bumpers (trained by Tom Weston on debut) but beaten 30l when fifth on 2m Exeter hurdle debut (good to soft) five weeks ago; tongue-tied on the back of that; Harry Cobden is on stablemate Babyken.

runners.comment: Looks more one for handicaps
runners.name: Corner Forward
runners.spotlight: Modest sixth at Hereford and Wincanton on his completed starts in maiden hurdles; seems unlikely to be of interest until handicapping.

runners.comment: 5-1 but tailed off on course bumper debut in November
runners.name: Louis Des Landes
runners.spotlight: Weakened quickly to finish tailed off on course bumper debut in November but the fact he went off at only 5-1 in that 11-runner race suggests better was anticipated.

runners.comment: Bumper winner but beaten at short odds on 2m4f  Sedgefield hurdle debut
runners.name: Marhaba Prince
runners.spotlight: Won the first of his three bumpers but turned over at short odds on his hurdle debut at Sedgefield (2m4f, soft) ten weeks ago and the winner didn't do much for that form at Newcastle since; back down in trip.

runners.comment: Runner-up in first of two bumpers; promising third on Hereford hurdle debut; will improve
runners.name: Western Cross
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the first of two bumpers and made an encouraging start over hurdles when running on for third of 14 at Hereford (2m, good to soft) 31 days ago; likely to improve.

runners.comment: Tailed off in a bumper and two hurdles
runners.name: Deauville Lady
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a bumper and two hurdles.

runners.comment: Third on her completed start in points but Way Of Stars is likely yard's main hope here
runners.name: Follow The Plan
runners.spotlight: Third on her completed start in 3m Irish points but the winner of that race could only manage a remote third on her recent hurdle debut; Way Of Stars looks the stable first string.

runners.comment: Flat win in France; bounced back from poor hurdle debut to chase home useful sort over C&D
runners.name: Babyken
runners.spotlight: First (2m) and second (1m4f) in two Flat runs in France; very disappointing when pulled up on Fontwell hurdle debut in October but more like it with a tongue-tie added (retained) when 17l second to Onlyforfrankie (won decent race at Musselburgh since) over C&D (good) five weeks ago; should be more to come for a leading stable in good form.

runners.comment: Fourth in two hurdles in Ireland and won't need to up his game too much for new yard
runners.name: Circle Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Fourth in a pair of academy hurdles in Ireland for Emmet Mullins, better effort when beaten just under 7l at Leopardstown (2m2f, good to yielding) over Christmas; has since switched to Fergal O'Brien; likely to be on the premises.

runners.comment: Useful on Flat; too free when third on hurdle but can improve if settling better in hood
runners.name: Way Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Useful peak RPR of 94 on the Flat for Andrew Balding; ran to a fair level when last of three finishers on Exeter hurdle debut (heavy) eight weeks ago and should prove capable of better, particularly if a first-time hood helps him to settle better through the early stages than he did on that occasion.

13:40.race_name: Free Raceday 9 March Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: No show in points and maiden/novice hurdles
runners.name: Eric Gorcombe
runners.spotlight: No show in points and maiden/novice hurdles.

runners.comment: Point win in November but well held in two hurdles since
runners.name: Fane Court
runners.spotlight: Won small-field Irish point in November but well held in two hurdles for new yard since; more one for handicaps after this

runners.comment: Bumper winner; promise when fifth of 13 on C&D hurdle debut; open to improvement
runners.name: Five Bar Gate
runners.spotlight: Won good-ground point bumper last season and built upon fairly encouraging first run under rules when winning Plumpton bumper (soft) in December; promise when fifth of 13 on C&D hurdle debut (good to soft) last month; open to improvement.

runners.comment: Placed in Irish point last spring but pulled up in two British points at end of 2025
runners.name: Georges Street
runners.spotlight: Placed in fast-ground Irish point last May but pulled up in two British points towards the end of 2025 ahead of this switch to hurdles.

runners.breeder: E A R L Du Loisir
runners.comment: £160,000 point buy; only sixth on hurdle debut but could fare lot better back from wind op
runners.name: Leader Crik
runners.spotlight: Bought for £160,000 soon after finishing a close second to a subsequent hurdle winner in an Irish point last May; well-held sixth of seven in Cheltenham novice hurdle (2m4f, good to soft; 10-1) in October but could fare a lot better back from wind surgery.

runners.comment: Third on Chepstow bumper debut but only seventh in bumper/maiden hurdle at Exeter since
runners.name: Sailing By
runners.owner: J M Dare T Hamlin J W Snook
runners.spotlight: Promising third on Chepstow bumper debut (2m, good to soft) in November but only seventh in a bumper and maiden hurdle at Exeter since; still early days with this one.

runners.comment: Fourth in a bumper in spring 2024 but last on hurdle debut last February; off again since
runners.name: Paradise Park
runners.spotlight: Absent since trailing home last in Uttoxeter novice hurdle a year ago, failing to back up her bumper effort; best watched.

runners.comment: Big shout on French hurdle form last summer but below that level in two runs for new yard
runners.name: Innamorato
runners.spotlight: Runner-up three times on the Flat in France; also made the frame in 3yo hurdles at Clairefontaine (both 2m1f, very soft) last summer but well below that level in two hurdles for new connections in recent months, including with cheekpieces added last time; needs to recapture the French form.

runners.comment: Second sole run in France; well held in Listed bumper on yard debut but retains potential
runners.name: Mariole
runners.spotlight: Close second over 1m4f (very soft) on sole start in France; weakened to finish tailed off in a Cheltenham Listed bumper for new connections on New Year's Day but the fact he went off at only 7-1 suggests better was anticipated; doesn't have a particularly high form standard to aim at on hurdle debut and has to be of interest, particularly if the betting vibes are strong.

14:15.race_name: Ross Stacey Still Cannot Cook Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Goes well in mud and runner-up at Hereford the last twice; ought to be in mix again
runners.name: Gower Spirit
runners.spotlight: Goes well in the mud, including a 2m4f mares' maiden success on heavy at Uttoxeter in November; runner-up in soft-ground handicaps over the extended 2m3f at Hereford on her last two outings; ought to be in the mix again.

runners.comment: Both wins on good, latterly over 2m here five weeks ago; faces very different ground today
runners.name: Broomfield Gale
runners.spotlight: Won at Stratford (2m6f) last May and back on the scoresheet with a stylish success over 2m here five weeks ago; still looks feasibly treated off 6lb higher but those wins were achieved on good and she'll face contrasting conditions afternoon.

runners.comment: Lightly raced and interesting on bumper form but he's been absent for 659 days
runners.name: Perfect Nelson
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in Irish bumpers (good/yielding) but failed to make an impact in four hurdle starts for this yard in the 2023-24 season, including when 28-1 for soft-ground C&D handicap debut; still has time on his side but would need to see market support to consider after 659 days off.

runners.comment: Would have won a point but for late fall but no show in four hurdles, including a handicap
runners.name: Jackomy
runners.spotlight: Would have won a 3m Irish point last March but for a last-fence fall but well held in four hurdles for new yard, including when 40-1 for 1m7f Wincanton handicap debut four weeks ago; best watched unless the betting hints that a better showing is anticipated.

runners.comment: Point winner; showed a bit over hurdles in 2024 but failed to complete back pointing since
runners.name: All Night Parking
runners.spotlight: Won a couple of points in spring 2024; didn't run too badly in three qualifying runs over hurdles for Carroll Gray in the summer of that year but off since failing to complete in two points last spring.

runners.comment: Third of ten over C&D on heavy last week and holds each-way claims again
runners.name: Ask Peter
runners.spotlight: Modest form over hurdles but last week's C&D third of ten on heavy shows she can be competitive from her mark.

runners.comment: Escapes a penalty for recent Market Rasen handicap debut win; the one to beat
runners.name: Cooler Than Me
runners.spotlight: Rallied after being headed to lead again towards the finish and make a successful handicap debut at Market Rasen (extended 2m4f, good to soft) in first-time cheekpieces (retained) 11 days ago; escapes a penalty and is 7lb well-in compared to his future mark.

runners.comment: Fast-ground Exeter success in October was first win on 29th start; different ground now
runners.name: Stage Show
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 29th time of asking (including Flat) when accounting for six rivals in 2m7f Exeter handicap hurdle (good to firm) under Isabelle Ryder in October; wore cheekpieces and a tongue-tie on that occasion but the former are left off this time; third on soft ground on the Flat but well beaten in three handicap hurdles on soft/heavy; hardly has the profile of one likely to follow up.

runners.comment: Close up when unseating two out here last February but well held back hurdling last twice
runners.name: Nobody Told Me
runners.spotlight: In contention when stumbled and unseated just after two out in a C&D handicap on heavy ground last February but comfortably held in two handicaps back hurdling towards the end of 2025.

runners.comment: Beaten 14l or more in all four handicaps and hard to make a case for
runners.name: Talap
runners.spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles and beaten 14l or more in all four handicaps; hard to make a case for.

runners.comment: Promising in bumpers/over hurdles but off 467 days ahead of chase debut
runners.name: Hell Hound
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate- Hell Hound
runners.spotlight: Bumper/maiden hurdle winner in the first half of 2024 but off since finishing fourth of eight in 2m3f Ascot novice handicap hurdle that November; a point background provides hope that he'll take to fences but the length of absence and the fact he's raced only on good/good to soft to date means a watching brief is advised unless the betting speaks for him; the stable also runs Jongleur d'Etoiles.

runners.comment: Four hurdle wins and showed he can do it over fences when second over C&D latest; player
runners.name: Jongleur dEtoiles
runners.spotlight: Four wins over hurdles, including twice on soft, and bettered any of his RPRs in that sphere when 10l second of ten to a next-time-out winner over C&D (good) six weeks ago; same mark this afternoon; should go well.

runners.comment: Got up late over C&D on good to soft latest; today's softer ground should suit even better
runners.name: Bataillon
runners.spotlight: Relished the step back up in trip when overhauling Ted The Thief from the last over C&D (good to soft) under Jack Stenhouse last month on just his second start over fences; today's ground (which he acts on) should place even more emphasis on stamina, which promises to suit him; gets the vote.

runners.comment: Came 15l clear at Huntingdon latest so a 10lb rise looks warranted
runners.name: Call Me Arthur
runners.spotlight: All the sharper for his Hereford reappearance when making it third time lucky over fences in 2m7f Huntingdon handicap (soft) three weeks ago, forging 15l clear; that resulted in a 10lb rise but he should remain competitive if in the same form.

runners.comment: Well held on recent chase debut but it was his first outing for 11 months; cheekpieces on
runners.name: The Blueberry One
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced gelding who already looked to be feeling the pinch when a bad mistake four out finished him off on his 2m4f Wincanton chase debut (heavy) a fortnight ago but that was his first outing for nearly 11 months so he's entitled to be sharper now; first-time cheekpieces are also added now stepping up in trip.

runners.comment: Has blinkers refitted as she bids to bounce back from a couple of lesser efforts
runners.name: Another Day Out
runners.spotlight: Three front-running chase wins, including at 3m (good to soft); two good efforts in the autumn but her race was run when falling heavily three out at Wincanton on Boxing Day and she could only manage a well-held fifth at Leicester since; second-time blinkers replace the cheekpieces she's worn on her last five outings.

runners.breeder: Miss Sally Harler & Mr Matthew Darling
runners.comment: 3m winner on heavy; also good second here in December but has run poorly since
runners.name: Gingerbred
runners.spotlight: Won at Ffos Las (3m, heavy) in February 2024 and plenty of good runs in defeat since, including runner-up over an extended 3m2f here at the end of December; last month's no show at Windsor needs forgiving, though.

runners.comment: Second in December but pulled up either side, taking chase record to 1-18; new headgear
runners.name: Shot Boii
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Wincanton (3m1f, soft) in December but never going after an early mistake when pulled up at Ludlow since, taking his overall chase record to 1-18; first-time blinkers replace regular visor.

runners.comment: C&D winner but couldn't live with Bataillon and Ted The Thief here last time
runners.name: School For Scandal
runners.owner: K Johns & Joe Tickle Racing Club
runners.spotlight: Former C&D winner who added to his tally at Worcester and Windsor in 2025 but weakened to finish a below-form fourth to Bataillon and Ted The Thief over C&D last time; might be vulnerable to younger legs here.

runners.comment: In good form but Bataillon was too strong for him over C&D latest and might be same again
runners.name: Ted The Thief
runners.spotlight: Winning pointer; has made a positive start for the Robert Walford stable, including second to Bataillon over C&D on good to soft last time; likely to figure prominently again but seemingly outstayed by his reopposing rival on that occasion and today's ground conditions are likely to place even more emphasis on stamina.

15:25.race_name: Royal Bath & West Show Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Won Haydock handicap last month and good effort in Grade 2 since; goes well in mud; player
runners.name: Brentford Hope
runners.spotlight: Back to winning ways in Haydock handicap (2m, good to soft) last month under Megan Fox; performed as well as could be expected in the face of a stiff task when third of four to The New Lion in Grade 2 at Cheltenham a week later; bold show likely back in handicap company on ground which suits.

runners.comment: Good course record, including second in this last year; fair third here latest; respected
runners.name: Aurigny Mill
runners.spotlight: Decent course record, including second in this last year off 4lb higher; showed himself none the worse for his chase debut fall at Kempton in November when third to Celtic Art over 2m3f here in first-time cheekpieces (retained) last month; claims if he can build on that; has won on heavy.

runners.comment: Won 2025 Scottish County at Musselburgh; unseated start when fav for same race 12 days ago
runners.name: Welsh Charger
runners.spotlight: Yet to run here but has a good record on other sharp, right-handed tracks, including a win in the quite valuable Scottish County at Musselburgh last February; looked to have been primed for another bold bid in this year's renewal of that race (7-2 favourite) only to unseat at the start 12 days ago; has won on soft but yet to encounter heavy.

runners.comment: Hurdle win in October; creditable fourth in chase latest; won previous start on heavy
runners.name: Spirits Bay
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs P Carter J A B Old M Sanders
runners.spotlight: Made a winning reappearance in Newton Abbot handicap hurdle (2m1f, good to soft) in October; switched to fences subsequently, matching his peak RPR over timber when fourth in 2m3f Exeter novice handicap (good to soft) five weeks ago; won his previous outing on heavy.

runners.comment: Dual 2m3f winner here on good/good to soft this winter but deeper ground today a worry
runners.name: Celtic Art
runners.spotlight: Has done very well over 2m3f here in recent months, winning twice and second in between; those results were achieved on good/good to soft and today's much deeper ground is a slight concern given he's been below par on both hurdle outings on heavy.

runners.comment: Good second of 15 in mud at Cheltenham (soft) in November; had wind op since; respected
runners.name: Jack Hyde
runners.owner: Paddy Brennan Racing Syndicate Jack Hyde
runners.spotlight: Added to his good record under conditional Tom Broughton when second of 15 in 2m Cheltenham novice handicap (soft; yet to race on heavy) in November; off since (has had wind surgery) but he's gone well fresh before; reasons to be positive.

runners.comment: Didn't take to fences latest but in form over hurdles before; C&D winner; declared Weds
runners.name: Into The Park
runners.spotlight: Looked promising in early 2024, including a soft-ground success in this race off 4lb lower; quite lightly raced since but nearly won over 2m4f at Uttoxeter on reappearance in October; fair fourth at Sandown next time and presumably simply failed to take to fences at Exeter since; the first-time cheekpieces he wore in Devon are retained; engaged 3.25 Wetherby Wednesday.

runners.comment: Progressive RPRs in maiden hurdles and likely more to come in handicaps
runners.name: Constellation Walk
runners.spotlight: Progressive form in three maiden hurdles around 2m on good to soft/soft, finishing third of 18 at Wincanton on latest eight weeks ago; has shown a tendency to race keenly but the likely stronger pace in a handicap may help him to settle better; open to further improvement.

16:00.race_name: Family Fun Day 9 April Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Won by 6l on recent hunter chase debut at Warwick and he's a leading candidate today
runners.name: Golden Son
runners.spotlight: Returned from an absence to win by 6l on his hunter chase debut at Warwick (3m, good to soft) three weeks ago; effective on testing ground earlier in his career and he's a leading candidate today.

runners.comment: 2nd in this last year; could improve for last month's return but others still appeal more
runners.name: Havent Time
runners.spotlight: Won hunter chase at Southwell (3m, soft) in March 2024 and runner-up in this race last February (good to soft); this 12yo was no match for Golden Son when fourth at Warwick (3m, good to soft) three weeks ago; could improve for that reappearance outing but others still make greater appeal.

runners.breeder: Mickley Stud D McCain & D & F Lockwood
runners.comment: Mishaps have been a feature across his last 3 starts and he's down the pecking order today
runners.name: Just Loose Change
runners.spotlight: Course hurdles winner in April 2023 and he won a handicap chase at Huntingdon in November 2024; mishaps have been a feature across his last three starts and he's down the pecking order today.

runners.comment: Returned to form to win on hunter chase debut at Hereford last month; contender
runners.name: Snipe
runners.spotlight: Returned to form and snapped a losing sequence on his hunter chase debut at Hereford (2m5f, soft) last month, when clear with a very talented runner-up; he can have another big say if backing up that latest performance.

runners.comment: Best known as very talented h'dler; entitled to considerable respect on hunter chase debut
runners.name: Beacon Edge
runners.spotlight: Best known as a very talented hurdler, also landing a Grade 1 novice chase in 2021; had jumping issues over fences subsequently and this is his first chase start since 2022; returned from some time off with a point win last month (3m, soft); it remains to be seen how much ability this 12yo retains but he's entitled to considerable respect on his hunter chase debut.

runners.comment: Very useful in his prime but that hasn't been the case more recently
runners.name: Revels Hill
runners.spotlight: Ran really well in defeat in some tough handicap chases in 2022-23 season and a good case can be made on that form; however, this 11yo has raced just three times since and is hard to fancy on that more recent evidence.

runners.comment: 10yo who has 4-19 record in points; makes rules debut in hot contest and looks vulnerable
runners.name: Whitsand Bay
runners.spotlight: 10yo who has a 4-19 record in points; pulled up in two points towards end of last year; makes rules debut in hot contest and looks vulnerable.

13:23.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Apprentice Handicap

runners.comment: Still a maiden but he arrives in good nick; he's very much one to consider eased 1lb
runners.name: Joseph
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden but he arrives in good nick, fourth of ten in 1m Newcastle handicap 23 days ago; that form has worked out well so he's very much one to consider eased 1lb.

runners.comment: Very good second in 1m Kempton handicap 15 days ago; he's a likely player once more
runners.name: Rising Force
runners.spotlight: In excellent form for his current yard, gaining a second course win over 1m in January before second of nine under a 5lb penalty in 1m Kempton handicap 15 days ago; he's a likely player once more.

runners.comment: Three-time C&D scorer; promising fourth on yard debut at Kempton eight days ago; big shout
runners.name: Masqool
runners.spotlight: A three-time C&D scorer for James Evans who shaped well on his yard debut when a running-on fourth of nine in 1m Kempton handicap eight days ago; big shout back up in trip off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Rusty after ten months off when 5th at Chelmsford latest; can progress now handicapping
runners.name: Daddy Chill
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in a pair of 1m AW novices for Andrew Balding early in 2025; looked rusty after ten months off for his new yard when fifth of seven in 1m Chelmsford maiden four weeks ago and can take a step forward now going handicapping.

runners.breeder: J Hanly A Stroud & Skymarc Farm
runners.comment: C&D winner; fading seventh over C&D in December and not discounted off an easing mark
runners.name: Crafter
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who shaped as if still in need of the run (second run back from five months off) when a fading seventh of ten over C&D in December; he can't be discounted off an easing mark with a tongue tie now added.

runners.comment: Solid third of nine for his new trainer in C&D h'cap 19 days ago; must enter calculations
runners.name: Beta Reader
runners.spotlight: It's now 11 runs since his sole victory but he posted a solid third of nine for his new trainer in C&D handicap 19 days ago; he must enter calculations.

runners.comment: Last of nine over C&D 19 days ago; hood goes back on now with work to do
runners.name: Tatmeen
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at Kempton (1m4f) last May but his more recent form is far less encouraging, last of nine over C&D 19 days ago; hood goes back on now with work to do.

13:58.race_name: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Novice Stakes (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Not seen since winning a Newmarket novice last April; remains a colt of potential
runners.name: Spanish Voice
runners.spotlight: Built on his promising Kempton debut as a 2yo when making all in a Newmarket novice (1m2f, good; first-time tongue-tie) last April (held Dante/Derby entries at the time); not seen since, but the form of that race worked out well and he remains a colt of potential.

runners.comment: Now 0-8 and a couple of these are open to more improvement
runners.name: Abando
runners.spotlight: Group 2-placed in Germany, but hasn't landed a telling blow in three starts here including on stable debut at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) last month; now 0-8 and a couple of these are open to more improvement.

runners.comment: Fourth in both starts at Haydock last summer; could well improve this year
runners.name: Bintkend
runners.spotlight: Fourth in both starts at Haydock (7f/1m2f) last summer, the form of the second race working out well; could well improve this year and is taken very seriously on her AW debut/reappearance.

runners.comment: Dual bumper winner last year; pedigree doesn't suggest this test is likely to suit
runners.name: Masked Mistress
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner last year and showed promise in the first of her two starts over hurdles; pedigree doesn't suggest this trip in a small field on her Flat debut is likely to suit, though.

runners.comment: 0-9 and looks vulnerable to an improver back up in trip
runners.name: Nuptown Girl
runners.spotlight: Best of her nine starts when second of eight on stable debut at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) last month, but didn't back it up at Kempton eight days ago; looks vulnerable to an improver back up in trip.

runners.comment: Two 5f nursery wins last year; disappointing latest; perhaps vulnerable to improvers
runners.name: Guernsey Angel
runners.spotlight: Two 5f nursery wins as a 2yo; disappointed at Southwell three weeks ago and could prove vulnerable to less-exposed rivals.

runners.comment: Placed in his five runs at Dundalk for new stable; others appeal as being better treated
runners.name: This Guy
runners.spotlight: Promise for Clive Cox last year and he has finished placed in five starts at Dundalk for his new stable since November; should give his running but not obviously ahead of his mark.

runners.comment: C&D win when last seen in August; more needed now handicapping but she's far from exposed
runners.name: Loleeta
runners.spotlight: Improved with each run last summer, getting off the mark at the fourth attempt with a front-running C&D win last August; hit with an 8lb rise for that and while she is still unexposed, this will demand another step forward.

runners.comment: Won well at Wolverhampton in December but a 6lb rise in a deeper race asks more of him
runners.name: U S S Charleston
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when winning a small-field nursery at Wolverhampton in December; that effort backed up by the Topspeed figure but the form is nothing special and a 6lb rise demands more.

runners.comment: Flew home to win easily over C&D on last month's stable debut; up 8lb; not fully exposed
runners.name: Henrythenate
runners.spotlight: 5f AW win for Charlie Fellowes last September; returned from an 87-day break to make a winning stable debut over C&D last month, powering home to win decisively; an 8lb rise not generous on the face of it but the third home won her next two starts and he could well have more in the tank; hold-up tactics won't be so easy to pull off from stall 1 but he has been prominently ridden in the past.

runners.comment: He has taken well to AW and showed 5f was no problem with latest 2nd; can miss the break
runners.name: Flash Rascal
runners.spotlight: Took well to the AW when winning a 6f nursery at Chelmsford in November; hasn't always had the rub of the green since but his latest second at Wolverhampton was a good effort (5f) and he runs off the same mark; can miss the break.

runners.comment: Promise in both nursery runs; not fully exposed and new yard quick to drop him in trip
runners.name: Wisetanck
runners.spotlight: Went close on his handicap debut at Kempton in December (6f); subsequent third at Southwell came in a Class 4 and this should be more manageable; new stable (same owner) quick to drop him in trip.

runners.comment: Wide-margin C&D win three weeks ago; 10lb higher against better oppositon and drawn widest
runners.name: Far Too Fizzy
runners.spotlight: Twice a winner in AW handicaps, latterly when storming clear in a C&D event three weeks ago; a 10lb rise asks plenty more of him and he's drawn widest to boot.

15:08.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap

runners.breeder: R C Dollar & Hellwood Stud Farm
runners.comment: On the downgrade but down in class and tried in new headgear; not discounted
runners.name: Captain Kinsella
runners.spotlight: Recorded an RPR of 79 when third of eight at Southwell on his handicap debut last March; regressed last summer and although he has run some respectable races this winter, last time wasn't one of them (bad draw); this is his first run at 0-55 level and blinkers are now given a go so a revival isn't out of the question.

runners.comment: Won classified event at Chelmsford last month but not quite so good back in a h'cap latest
runners.name: Flickas Girl
runners.spotlight: Made most when winning a classified event at Chelmsford last month; only fourth at Wolverhampton ten days ago, a race where she finished behind Kento, and others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: Multiple sprint winner but his powers look on the wane; minor money perhaps his best hope
runners.name: The Defiant
runners.spotlight: Multiple 5f winner down the years, including over C&D, but his powers appear to be on the wane; a couple of respectable efforts last month but more will be needed to win.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but ran his best race for a while ten days ago; claims if building on it
runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 24 starts but he ran his best race for some time when chasing home a shorter-priced stablemate at Wolverhampton ten days ago; in the mix once again.

runners.comment: 16-race maiden but in good form at Dundalk and this is less competitive; solid claims
runners.name: An Laochmor
runners.spotlight: 0-16 in Ireland but he has threatened, including on AW, and only an unexposed 3yo was too strong for him at Dundalk three weeks ago (5f; heavily backed); this is less competitive than he is used to and unlikely to be found a better opportunity.
